verdict.rationale: Using a tablet or spare device as an extended display is a fair question for a remote-desktop and screen-sharing product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an extended-display or virtual second-monitor mode; it covers only remote access, IT management, AR assistance and AI features.

support.subject: As a power user, a tablet or spare device works as an additional display that extends the desktop, not only a mirror of it
